content:
Priya: quick micro-poll — if each open model were a coworker, whod be the one stealing your favorite pen vs bringing bagels? :thinking_face:
Jordan: Llama2 brings bagels on Mondays, always calm. Mistral is the one who borrows your charger and never returns it :charger:
Amina: Falcon is that person whos in 3 meetings at once and replies with a single emoji :cat::shrug:
Diego: can we get a sticker: "I survived a midnight stress test with Rika-3"? also vote: :pen: for pen-stealer, :bagel: for bagel-bringer
Nina: Vicuna = emotional support coworker. Brings cookies when your evals fail. Pen-stealer: Mistral. Bagel-bringer: Llama2.
Priya: idea: "Model Adoption Certificate" template we can print for the lunch. quick mock:
```
CERTIFICATE OF ADOPTION
This certifies that [NAME] adopts [MODEL] as their official office pet.
Adoptive perks: 1 free coffee, 1 sticker, endless pings.
Signed: Head of Ops
```
Jordan: love it. can we have a variant thats a magnet with the models persona on the back?
Amina: low-effort merch idea: enamel pins. raccoon for Mistral, sleepy owl for OpenAssistant, tiny labrador for Llama2.
Diego: tiny rant: please stop naming infra hosts after models. my oncall at 2am: "mistral-57" came back as an alert and I pictured a raccoon running a server rack. traumatized. :sweat_smile:
Priya: @lunchbot is "Adopt a Model" lunch on the calendar? budget for magnets + stickers? :wallet:
lunchbot: Heads up  "Adopt a Model" lunch approved for next Friday. Catering options pending. Budget owner: @PeopleOps.
Nina: if PeopleOps says yes, I will 3D-print a tiny raccoon that holds a tiny sandwich.
Jordan: vote tallies (informal): :bagel: 6, :pen: 2, :raccoon: 4, :owl: 3. Looks like bagels win.
Priya: final: anyone want to actually run a mini prompt contest where teams write the funniest persona prompt? winner gets a bagel + enamel pin. :tada:
